semantic-review.md.content:
# Candidate 3 assessment

**0/5 complete milestones accepted.** Substantial verified partials are A (exact prefix) and B (original full Erasure file). All inventory files are regular source; the allowed tree contains no TARGETS.md or project build configuration, and does not establish a final submitted-versus-working-draft designation. These results concern the frozen source tree.

## Accepted partials

**A, exact prefix only:** Original Parameters lines 1–45, followed solely by closing namespace/section ends, freshly compile and import downstream. A_commutes, P_inl, P_inr, D_inl, D_inr, A_length and A_dimension all depend only on propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. They establish the actual physical checks, commutation, length and genuine Z homology dimension with no rank/nonempty assumptions. See parameters-prefix-manifest.json and targeted-Parameters-{compile,import-audit}.txt.

**B, full Erasure file:** The required fresh checker built the unchanged file, and a subsequent downstream import/axiom audit passed all ten selected definitions/lemmas, with only the permitted axioms. supportedLogical is an honest quotient image of supported cycles; zDim/xDim swap actual matrix kernel/range sectors. supportedDim_add_finrank proves supported logical image dimension plus supported-boundary dimension equals supported-cycle dimension. Support/restriction and rank-nullity helpers are genuine. Neither restricted-check rank identity nor either complement-cleaning identity is present. See targets.json, full-evaluation/command-001.stdout and erasure-import-audit.txt.

## Failures and missing results

**A remainder:** The original full-file Lake build was interrupted by supervisor direction. A serialized aggregate replay retaining all original A/E proof bytes gives concrete source errors: A_cohomology_dimension references an unknown QEC lemma; both representative bounds reference unknown Submodule.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem and lack a DecidablePred instance. These three declarations report sorryAx. Full A is therefore not accepted.

**C:** No syndrome/error equivalence, zero-supported-logical ambiguity criterion, failure definition or least-failing-erasure/CSS-distance theorem.

**D:** Neither numerical physical-strip identity is stated. Generic TensorStrip attempts do not build: original direct compilation fails first at line 18 with Min(Type), then with tensor-kernel equality and other type/simp errors. Restriction fails its first lemma at line 10 and references absent cycles_supported_finrank. The single exact Restriction prefix also fails and reports sorryAx. No substantial D partial is accepted. No proofs were repaired.

**E:** Actual five/eight HGP objects are defined, but the repetition-kernel simp proof fails, contaminating kernel/dimension/distance claims. five_dimension/five_distance also fail rewriting. The witness construction has a Nat-versus-Bit coordinate mismatch and heartbeat failure, followed by kernel unknown-constant failures. Do not accept the misleading empty axiom report for the failed generic witness constant. Only five_length, eight_length, repetitionCheck_surjective and five_transpose_kernel_dimension have clean axiom reports in the failing aggregate; these are small observed components, not an importable E result. All supported-dimension examples and single-erasure/strip success/failure call sites are absent.

## Verification provenance

The requested check_submission invocation, taskset CPUs 4,5 and timeout 500 are recorded in commands.txt. It built Erasure, timed out Examples, and was interrupted during Parameters after the parent supervisor diagnosed page-cache thrashing. full-evaluation/interrupted.json preserves that distinction; there is no completed checker report for that attempt.

Follow-ups used direct fresh Lean source compilation/import and axiom evaluation, serialized for QEC imports with preflight/grade-import.lock. The aggregate AE replay shares its identical import once, closes anonymous sections, preserves both original proof-byte sequences, and appends checks/axiom reports. It is explicitly an aggregate replay, not full-file acceptance. Its transformation/source hashes are in aggregate-replay-manifest.json. A's accepted prefix also has a separate successful compiler and downstream import audit. Log/source hashes are collected in evidence-sha256.json. assessment.json provides the structured verdict and exact selected declarations.

Only candidate-3/source.md, acceptance.md, inventory.json and tree/ were inspected as contestant material; no other candidates, group labels or participant run traces were read. No commits or contestant-source changes were made.
